name: Choi 2025 denosumab SB16 PopPK/PD scenarios
description: Typical-subject QSS-TMDD/BMD scenarios and source-limited population-endpoint diagnostics. Historical scalar replays are disabled reference records.

scenarios.name: SB16 60 mg SC Q6M x3 Table 5 dynamic overlay
scenarios.description: Fixed-effect public ODE simulation for SB16 after 60 mg SC at months 0, 6, and 12. Paper comparators are the Table 5 population median and 90 percent PI endpoints.

scenarios.name: Reference denosumab 60 mg SC Q6M x3 Table 5 dynamic overlay
scenarios.description: Fixed-effect public ODE simulation for reference denosumab after 60 mg SC at months 0, 6, and 12. Paper comparators are the Table 5 population median and 90 percent PI endpoints.

scenarios.name: PMO, 64 kg, Caucasian: typical 60 mg SC Q6M response
scenarios.description: Deterministic fixed-effect projection for the covariate conditions in Figures 6 and 7. Population medians and prediction intervals are not reproduced. PMO is an explicit assumption for the weight/race panels. BMD in healthy volunteers is a model extrapolation, not observed Phase I PD.

scenarios.name: Untreated PMO physiological baseline
scenarios.description: No-dose structural control: RANKL and BMD must remain at their population-specific steady state. This checks the implementation, not a reported clinical control arm.

scenarios.name: Untreated HV physiological baseline
scenarios.description: No-dose structural control: RANKL and BMD must remain at their population-specific steady state. This checks the implementation, not a reported clinical control arm.

scenarios.name: Healthy volunteer: single 60 mg SC dose
scenarios.description: Typical healthy-volunteer PK over the Phase I sampling window. Reference weight 64 kg and Caucasian clearance are explicit assumptions, not the Phase I cohort distribution. BMD is an unobserved model extrapolation.
